result.reason: The redline appropriately permits Licensee assignments to affiliates and transaction successors and removes Licensor’s change-of-control termination/consent right. However, it does not address Licensor’s assignment rights at all. The preferred position requires Licensor assignments to be subject to Licensee consent, not unreasonably withheld, and absolutely prohibits assignment to a Licensee competitor; even the fallback requires mutual successor-assignment rights with notice and consent for other assignments. The retained right of first refusal may also continue to burden the contemplated merger or asset-sale transactions. Drafting defects remain, including the missing punctuation before “Subject to the terms of this Section” and a potentially inconsistent cross-reference to Section 13.4(a).
